package postgres_test

import (
	"os"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestOnboardingPathExecutionMigrationPersistsFencedEvidenceAndGuardsIt(t *testing.T) {
	up, err := os.ReadFile("../../../../db/migrations/010_onboarding_path_execution.up.sql")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	migration := string(up)
	for _, required := range []string{"CREATE TABLE onboarding_path_execution", "CREATE TABLE onboarding_path_execution_lesson_content", "lesson_index integer", "ai_idempotency_key uuid", "content_json jsonb", "content_hash char(64)", "admission_id uuid", "admission_fence bigint", "admission_expires_at", "reserve_key uuid NOT NULL UNIQUE", "course_lesson_bindings_json", "student_command_hash", "trg_protect_onboarding_path_execution", "trg_protect_onboarding_path_execution_lesson_content", "BEFORE DELETE", "BEFORE TRUNCATE", "FOR EACH STATEMENT", "write-once", "monotonic"} {
		if !strings.Contains(migration, required) {
			t.Fatalf("missing %q", required)
		}
	}
	down, err := os.ReadFile("../../../../db/migrations/010_onboarding_path_execution.down.sql")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for _, required := range []string{"LOCK TABLE onboarding_path_execution IN ACCESS EXCLUSIVE MODE", "cannot remove onboarding_path_execution while durable execution evidence exists", "trg_prevent_onboarding_path_execution_delete", "trg_prevent_onboarding_path_execution_truncate", "trg_protect_onboarding_path_execution_lesson_content", "DROP TABLE onboarding_path_execution_lesson_content", "DROP TABLE onboarding_path_execution"} {
		if !strings.Contains(string(down), required) {
			t.Fatalf("down missing %q", required)
		}
	}
}
